name: linkly
description: linkly — an LLM-native programming platform: a language, a semantic IR, a native compiler, a runtime, a knowledge base, and an agent protocol.

plugins.name: lnpl
plugins.description: Authoring, verification, and KB routing for `.lnpl` — closed-vocabulary references generated from the compiler's own tables, write-time compile diagnostics, a completion gate, and spec-case derivation.

plugins.name: lnpl-dev
plugins.description: Contributor tooling for linkly itself — environment preconditions, RFC process lint, and the mutation-harness traps.

plugins.name: lnpl-mcp
plugins.description: The LNPL compiler as MCP tools — structured diagnostics instead of stderr prose, and knowledge-base routing before a design decision.
